Among our top gifts, Heron Glacier often feels the most distinct and special. Its classic alpine design features removable leather side shields and a leather bridge cover, giving it a unique heritage look while providing extraordinary protection outdoors.
Alternatively, Howlin' offers a timeless round silhouette combined with high-performance V52® optics, making it a highly versatile choice for daily wear. Both models include a signature detachable headstrap.
